name: to-tickets
description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges (landing in the repo's OpenSpec tasks.md or .scratch/{feature-slug}/issues/). Use when a spec or plan has converged and is ready to split into executable units — 拆 ticket / 排 task / to-tickets, or when the local pipeline reaches its ticketing stage after to-spec. Do not use for: single-step fixes too small to slice, or editing an existing ticket set (edit it directly).
